levels.description: Deal 15% more damage to Devils, Demons, and Impids.
Take 10% less damage from Devils, Demons, and Impids.
Gain the Fiend's Bane passive, improving Hunter's Mark by 15% damage and 20% Accuracy.

effects.name: Fiend's Bane
effects.description: Hunter's Mark grants another 15% damage and 20% Accuracy; your attacks deal another 10% damage to Devils, Demons, and Impids.

levels.description: Unlock Exorcising Strike: once per combat, your next attack deals 40% more damage, or 100% more against Devils, Demons, and Impids.

effects.name: Exorcising Strike
effects.description: Once per combat, your next weapon attack gains 40% power, plus 60% more against Devils, Demons, and Impids.
